up: Retrieve all activity records for the assay with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL4513219. For each activity record, output the compound identifier (molecule_chembl_id), the standard type (standard_type), the relation (standard_relation), the numeric value (standard_value), the units (standard_units), and the pChEMBL value (pchembl_value). Include all rows from the activities table that are linked to this assay. Do not apply any additional filters (e.g., no restriction on relation, units, or target type). Return all matching rows without imposing a limit.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513219';
